FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Virginia fishing licence

Visitors need the correct freshwater or saltwater coverage unless exempt. Designated stocked trout waters can require an additional trout licence.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 16 or older, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16 need no fishing or trout licence.
  • Anglers aged 65 or older need no saltwater licence, but FIP registration requirements remain.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident freshwater 1-daynon resident1 day$20 USD
Non-resident freshwater 5-daynon resident5 consecutive days$36 USD
Non-resident fresh/saltwater 5-daynon resident5 consecutive days$46 USD
Non-resident freshwater annualnon residentAnnual$72 USD
Non-resident fresh/saltwater annualnon residentAnnual$96 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Non-resident stocked-trout licence · $48 USD
    Required when designated stocked trout-water rules apply, in addition to freshwater coverage.
  • Fisherman Identification Program registration
    Applies to specified saltwater anglers exempt from a licence.

Saltwater

Separate saltwater coverage or a combined licence is available. Licence-exempt anglers can still need FIP registration.

Fishing with a guide or charter

A licensed saltwater charter boat, headboat, or pier covers the individual saltwater licence requirement.

Rules visitors should know

  • A designated trout-area daily-use permit can be required.
  • Carry the licence and show it on request; an electronic copy is accepted.

How to buy

Use Go Outdoors Virginia, its mobile app, licence agents, DWR headquarters, or 804-367-1000.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Virginia?

Visitors need the correct freshwater or saltwater coverage unless exempt. Designated stocked trout waters can require an additional trout licence.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Virginia?

Non-resident freshwater 1-day: $20 USD; Non-resident freshwater 5-day: $36 USD; Non-resident fresh/saltwater 5-day: $46 USD; Non-resident freshwater annual: $72 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Virginia?

Use Go Outdoors Virginia, its mobile app, licence agents, DWR headquarters, or 804-367-1000.
